Patch 0.0.3.11 - The Advertisement Efficacy Patch
Overview: This patch introduces two extremely important changes that deepen strategic gameplay. First, several key actions now require a "click and hold," adding a deliberate, tactile feel to important decisions. The second and most significant change is a complete overhaul of the Advertisement system, giving managers unprecedented control over the flow of guests to their Hotel.

[hr][/hr]
Core Gameplay Changes

 Click and Hold Actions: To ensure Commanders are making deliberate choices, several critical actions now require a "click and hold" to confirm. This applies to Renovation, Docking, and Purchases.
 Dynamic Starts: Every manager now begins their career with a bustling Hotel! You will start with 4 guests pre-booked to your docks and a completely full river of 12 available guests. These pre-booked guests will dock automatically at the start of Shift 2, but you have the entire first shift to override these bookings with more desirable guests from orbit.

[hr][/hr]
The New Advertisement System

The Art of Attraction
We've overhauled the advertisement system to give you more direct and strategic control over attracting your desired clientele. Your ability to draw a specific guest is now determined by two key factors: your Location and the power of your Advertisement Campaigns.

1. Location: The Local Traffic

 Home System: The local Faction or Guild gets a large number of "attraction tokens," making them the most common sight in orbit.
 Adjacent Systems: Factions adjacent to your current location get a moderate number of tokens.
 Opposite Systems: The Faction opposite your location (as defined by the Rule of 6) gets the fewest tokens, making them a rare, natural spawn.

2. Advertisement Campaigns: Targeted Influence

 Each advertisement campaign you run adds more tokens for that Faction or Guild to the pool, directly increasing their chances of appearing. Note: All active campaigns of a specific type lose 1 charge per day.
 Upgraded Campaigns: Investing in upgraded campaigns significantly multiplies their effectiveness, making your call across the galaxy much harder to ignore.

Predictable Power: The Result
By combining a smart location with targeted, upgraded campaigns, you can dramatically influence your odds.

 Best Case Scenario: If you are in a Deep system and run six fully upgraded campaigns for The Deep, you can stack the odds to as high as an 80% chance of the next guest being from The Deep.
 Worst Case Scenario: Even if you're in an opposite territory (a Dread system), those same six upgraded campaigns can overcome the location disadvantage to still give you a powerful 63% chance of attracting a Deep guest.

Advertisement Cost: The Price of a Sure Thing
Booking a guest directly from the river is no longer free; it now requires an investment of Advertisement Actions.

 Cost by Column: The river consists of 6 columns. The cost to book a guest is 6 Advertisement Actions on the far left (Column 0) and scales down to just 1 on the far right (Column 5).
 Reducing the Cost: Each matching Advertisement Campaign you have active reduces a guest's booking cost by 1. Upgrades do not provide an additional cost reduction.
 Example: A Deep guest in the far-left column costs 6 Advertisement Actions. If you have six active campaigns for The Deep, their cost is reduced by 6, making them completely free to book. This system rewards managers who specialize their advertising, allowing them to book desirable guests for a fraction of the cost. Ultimately, a prime location gives you a strong head start, but a powerful ad campaign ensures your message reaches the guests you want, no matter where you are in the galaxy.


2. Dynamic Start: Your First Shift
The start of the game is now much more dynamic. Every manager begins their career with a bustling Hotel:

 You now start with 4 guests pre-booked directly to your docks.
 The river is completely full with 12 available guests.

At the beginning of your second shift, if the "Vacancy" sign is on, these 4 pre-booked guests will automatically dock at your Hotel for no cost, giving you a guaranteed start.
However, your first shift is a crucial window of opportunity. At any time during this first shift, you have the strategic choice to override any of these pre-booked guests by spending the necessary resources to dock a more desirable guest from orbit, allowing you to customize your opening strategy from the very first turn.

notes.title: Snohe is King
notes.content:
The Snohe is King Patch
Overview: This patch introduces two landmark changes. First, a back to the way it used to be overhaul of guest satisfaction rebalances Hotel strategy around the importance of Beds. Second, we've unlocked the galactic marketplace, allowing managers to purchase previously quest-locked hotel features directly! This is paired with our usual host of QoL improvements, art upgrades, and bug fixes.
[hr][/hr]
Core Rule & Gameplay Changes

 Buy Anything! (FREE-895): The economy has been opened up! Players can now purchase previously quest-locked items—including Vaults, Action Activity Stations, and Battery Storage. While completing the quest series may still be a more cost-effective route, managers with deep pockets can now accelerate their Hotel's development. Snohe is King!
 Guest Satisfaction Overhaul (FREE-904, FREE-889): The core rules for guest satisfaction have been updated. Guests (with the exception of the self-sufficient Bar Patrons) now require an adjacent, staffed Bed to be satisfied. Docking next to a matching Amenity alone is no longer sufficient.
 Ghost Handler Charge Rules (FREE-903): The rules for how Ghost Handlers are charged have been adjusted for better balance and clarity: 1 charge, 1 cleanse, 0 chance. No more daily tick. A cleansed Hotel is an efficient Hotel.

[hr][/hr]
New Features & Art Upgrades

 New Repair Animation (FREE-891): A brand new "Lock and Key" animation has been added for room repairs, providing better visual feedback.
 High-Resolution Assets (FREE-868, FREE-863, FREE-858, FREE-855): All the Manager updates directly affected the Vacancy icons. Everything pops way more now.
 Size Inclusive (FREE-861): All characters now have varying scale. Let the kids in!

[hr][/hr]
Quality of Life & UI Improvements

 TrackerMaps Implemented (FREE-907): New TrackerMaps have been added to improve navigation and information flow. Including: Player Tracking, Ghast Tracking, and Ghost Handler Tracking. Check out the improved Ghost Workstation to see these maps.
 Faction Colored Lodging Charges (FREE-888): To improve readability at a glance, Lodging Stations will now display charges in their corresponding Faction's color.
 New GuestScan HUD (FREE-880): A GuestScan key has been added to the HUD for easier access to the guest scanner (see guests through walls for a time).
 New Trolley Form (FREE-871): The Trolley has a new form clearly showing The Little Girl’s gift.

[hr][/hr]
Major Bug Fixes

 Orbital Accuracy (FREE-910): Fixed a persistent and frustrating bug that was causing the wrong guest ships to appear in orbit.
 Zygnus Fixes (FREE-869, FREE-865): Addressed an issue where Zygnus doors would not remain open after the initial sequence. Pickups on the Zygnus will now be immediately visible upon arrival without requiring a manual ping.
 Deep System Visibility (FREE-883): The Deep faction's home system will no longer be incorrectly visible after Hotel selection.
 Docking & Guest Resets (FREE-887): Fixed a critical bug where forcing a guest ship into a Ghosted Dock would improperly reset the guest ship.
 Damaged Rooms (FREE-866): Corrected a state where a room could be damaged but have no available repair points.
 General Fixes (FREE-901, FREE-885, FREE-867, FREE-864): Addressed a wide range of smaller bugs, including issues with Bartable warnings, the Tron Shadow Selector, incorrect hover text values on Advertisement cards, and battery charge logic.

[hr][/hr]
Manager Manual & Components

 HSH Manager Manual (FREE-886, FREE-882, FREE-859): The Haunted Space Hotel: Manager manual has been completely rebuilt and updated to reflect all recent rule changes, including new flowcharts for key gameplay loops.
 High-Resolution Assets (FREE-868, FREE-863, FREE-858, FREE-855): Expect to see stunning improved versions of guest ships, guest cards, the main logo, and various icons.
 Physical Card Printing (FREE-878, FREE-872, FREE-851): The latest version of the Manager cards have been sent for printing.
 Strategicon (FREE-890, FREE-857, FREE-856): The pitch, video edit, and final submission for Strategicon have been completed.

[hr][/hr]
Community Updates

 Release to Curators (FREE-849): The latest build has been released to curators for review.
 More Merch! (FREE-853): Investigated new merch options for the community.

notes.title: Vacancy 0.0.3.5 - The You Eye Patch
notes.content:
Overview: This patch, "The You Eye Patch," delivers a significant visual upgrade to your command interface with meticulously crafted HUD overlays for each Faction, further refines the crucial first-contact demo experience, and includes important backend changes for our Steam presence and DNS infrastructure.

New Features & Improvements

 Immersive Faction HUD Overlays: A major visual and experiential enhancement! We've introduced completely redesigned, distinct HUD overlays for each of the 6 Faction/Commander types. Each overlay features unique new artwork and thematic elements, meticulously crafted to deepen your immersion and provide a distinct visual language for your chosen command style [FREE-802].
 Refined Demo Experience: Understanding the importance of a Commander's first foray into The Hotel, the playable demo experience has been carefully tuned. The progression now thoughtfully guides players through the "Open Hotel" quest sequence, culminating after an additional 6 in-game Shifts. This structure, managed via the Director Controller, is designed to offer a substantial and engaging introduction to the universe of Haunted Space Hotel: Vacancy [FREE-672].

Backend & Infrastructure Updates


 Steam Presence: Ongoing work to implement new Steam presence features [FREE-813].
 DNS Migration: The domain hauntedspacehotel.com has been migrated from AWS to Google DNS and Google Sites for improved infrastructure [FREE-462].

Commanders, we're continually working to enhance your experience managing the most unique hotel in the galaxy. Your feedback helps us navigate these cosmic constructions!

notes.title: Haunted Space Hotel v0.0.2.0 - The Lurking Tendrils Update
notes.content:
Haunted Space Hotel v0.0.2.0 - The Lurking Tendrils Update

Lurking in the Shadows 👻


Lur Curs: Encounter the Lur Curs, elusive spectral entities that lie in wait, ready to ensnare unsuspecting Commanders.
Plants: Verdant additions to The Hotel, providing a touch of natural beauty and strategic hiding spots for Lur Curs.


Building Bonanza 🏨


All New Building Models: Immerse yourself in the refined aesthetics of 22 redesigned building models.


Spectral Shift 🌌


Evolving Ghosts: Ghosts now evolve over time, adding a new layer of challenge to spectral management.
Limit Ghasts Based on Snohe: Ghast populations are now tied to the Snohe stored in the Vaults, adding a strategic layer to resource management.


Engine Upgrade 🚀


Move to Unreal Engine 5.4: Experience enhanced visual fidelity, improved performance, and expanded possibilities with the upgrade to Unreal Engine 5.4.


Bug Fixes 🐞


Building Damage: Buildings are now immune to damage.
Ghost Bumping: Resolved an issue where Ghosts were being bumped off the navmesh.


This update redefines the spectral landscape and enhances the immersive experience of managing an intergalactic hotel.

notes.title: Ghostly Lights and Cosmic Frights Update
notes.content:
This patch focuses on enhancing the spectral atmosphere, improving gameplay clarity, and optimizing performance for a smoother and more immersive Haunted Space Hotel experience.

Features:

 Ghost Asteroids with Spectral Lightning: Venture into uncharted territories and encounter Ghost Asteroids, spectral remnants crackling with eerie lightning.
 Trolly Ding: The trusty Trolly now announces its arrival with a cheerful "ding," signaling its readiness to clear those pesky spectral infestations.
 Quest UI Progress Meter Returns: Track your progress towards completing those epic quests with the restored Quest UI progress meter.

Optimizations:

 Building Mesh Consolidation: We've streamlined those building meshes to boost those frame rates and keep your gameplay smooth as a Ley Lane.

notes.title: Vacancy 0.0.1.11 - Ghost Eco System
notes.content:
Ghost Eco Systems! This patch focuses on refining core gameplay mechanics, enhancing the player experience, and expanding the lore and narrative of the Haunted Space Hotel universe.

Features:

 Ghostly Encounters: A new quest, "Find the Ank Cur," challenges Commanders to track down and neutralize these elusive spectral entities.
 Spectral Ecosystem: The Ghast Ecosystem has been expanded, adding depth and complexity to the interactions between different types of Ghosts.
 Spectral Detection: Commanders now have access to a Ghost Scanner/Flashlight, enhancing their ability to detect and interact with spectral entities.
 Ley Lane Revelations: Lightning strikes in Ley Lanes now temporarily reveal Ghosts, adding a new dimension to interdimensional travel.
 Trolly Boost: The Trolly, a crucial tool for Ghost removal, now starts partially charged, allowing for quicker response to spectral disturbances.
 Guided Onboarding: A new "Start the Game Quest" guides new Commanders through the initial stages of The Hotel's management, providing a smoother onboarding experience.
 Time Manipulation: The game now starts with Time Stopped, allowing new Commanders to familiarize themselves with the interface before activating the flow of time through a dedicated quest.
 New Advertisement System: A new Roll system has been added to advertisements, increasing the chances of success and adding a layer of unpredictability to marketing campaigns.
 Improved Logging: The log system has been enhanced to accurately display information, providing valuable insights into The Hotel's operations.
 Reimagined Limbo: The Commander's initial experience in Limbo has been revamped, offering a more immersive and informative introduction to the Haunted Space Hotel universe.
 Multiplayer Enhancements: Significant progress has been made towards implementing multiplayer functionality, bringing cooperative gameplay closer to reality.

notes.title: Vacancy 0.0.1.10 - All Guilds Available
notes.content:
This patch enhances gameplay with Quest Machines in Amenities and a rebalanced reward system for guest types. Visual updates refresh Lodging Rooms and Stem items, and all Guild Quests are now available. Lore is congealed, a Science Academy skin is added, and performance is improved.  Fixes address various glitches and display issues for a smoother experience.
Features:
Quest Machines added to all Amenities.
Core Rules Change: Amenities now only provide 2 extra points if they match the guest's type, not if they are upgraded.
Pirates are now categorized as Patrons.
Updated skins for Lodging Rooms and other Stem items.
All Guild Quests are now implemented.
Canonical Lore Document has been finalized.
Cool Science Academy Skin added.
Ray Tracing removed to improve frame rates on Guest skeletons.
Ghost Crystals now swirl.
Fixes:
Quest machine reward index.
Action station duplication removed.
Map selector for seed science guild sector.
Room Service for Pirates had a blank destination.
Observatory Niagara was appearing in small hotels.
Ley Space was missing the initial hotel selection.
Consolidated a bunch of meshes for improved frame rates.
Bar Room glasses when small.
Removed ray tracing for skeletal meshes (for now), to improve performance.

notes.title: Vacancy 0.0.1.8 Room Service
notes.content:
The Trolly in Room Service is ready to assist with requests.
 Room Service has updated help.
 2D icons can now be generated from 3D icons.
 Action Generators now drop pickups.
 Glass colliders have been removed, allowing players to fly outside the hotel.
 The End of Day Report has been improved with new icons.
 Changes have been made to the Quest and Choice tree frames.
 New metallics have been added to the Bridge Map area.
 The map selector icons have been reversed for better understanding.
 Text for upcoming quests has been added and will be available in the next patch.


Fixes:

 Upgraded action rooms that were missing storage.
 The "What room is this in now" feature now works better with large rooms.
 Main menu music has been restored.
 Quest indicator now updates correctly.
 NPCs can now find the front desk.
 Stray 3D ships in orbit have been removed.
